name: Health Icons
about: Health Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 3,391 icons designed by Resolve to Save Lives. Covers common healthcare, pharmacy and medical symbols for health apps and websites. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Health Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 3,391 Health Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: What symbols do Health Icons include?
faqs.a: Common healthcare, pharmacy and medical symbols for health apps and websites. Search the set for the symbol you need – every icon downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP.

faqs.q: How do I use Health Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Health Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 3,391 icons in the Health Icons set, designed by Resolve to Save Lives. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Health Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
